title: BoxPvP Network
description: Our server features 4 exciting game modes for you to enjoy! Choose from BoxPvP, Crystal Box, Box Practice, and Random Kits. With regular updates releasing on the server, you'll never run out of ways to have fun.
body:
## Welcome to BOXPVP

BOXPVP is a Java Minecraft server for players who just want to fight. 
No fluff, no overcomplicated systems, pick a mode, jump in, and compete. 
The server runs smooth, stays active with **250+ players daily**, and supports 
everything from **1.19.4 - latest** so getting in is never an issue.

Both **premium and cracked** players are welcome.

![FEATHER_X_BOXPVP](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c99ef557694b1a2984cdc0fe9bed0105fe760095_0.webp)

## Game Modes

![hubb](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d8c02a0da41490dbad391812cab09958f134bf6f.png)

## BoxPvP 
Mine, gear up, and fight. Classic box arena gameplay where progression and PvP go hand in hand. You start with nothing, mine to get better gear, and take 
fights when you feel ready.

## Crystal Box 
Fast, precise, and unforgiving. Built for players who know crystal PvP and want real competition. If you've put hours into learning the mechanics, this is where you actually get to use them against people who have too.

## Box Practice 
Work on your mechanics without the pressure. Good place to sharpen combos, test timings, and get comfortable before jumping into the sweatier modes. 
No stakes, just reps.

## How to Join

- **IP:** `play.boxpvp.net`
- **Website:** [boxpvp.net](https://boxpvp.com)
- **Versions:** 1.19.4 - latest
- **Edition:** Java
- **Access:** Premium and Cracked

## Community

Stay updated and connect with other players on the official BOXPVP Discord.

**[Join the Discord](https://discord.gg/z99kbkxahQ)**
